fields.Name: IT74 - Queue Engine Lifecycle
fields.Description: Deterministic lifecycle of the MJQueue subsystem (packages/MJQueue) against the real engine loop and the real DB substrate — no LLM calls (the shipped AIActionQueue driver is resolved but never executed). QU1: QueueManager.Config loads the seeded queue-type catalog ('AI Action'/'Entity AI Action') plus the bundle's fixture type from the live DB. QU2: the ClassFactory resolves queue-type names to the shipped drivers, including the priority-1 EntityAIActionQueue subclass chain. QU3: a task fed through the real AddTask/ProcessTasks/StartTask path persists Status=Completed with its Output and frees its concurrency slot. QU4: a failing ProcessTask persists Status=Failed with the JSON-serialized exception. QU5: a THROWING ProcessTask cannot wedge the queue — the slot is freed and a subsequent task on the same queue still completes (the pinned slot-leak fix). QU6: Stop() is idempotent and a stopped queue refuses AddTask. QU7: static AddTask with an unknown type name throws the documented error before any DB write; instance AddTask against an inactive type returns undefined with zero writes. UN-GATED 2026-08-11: the blocking defect is fixed. QueueBase.StartTask ignored the boolean Save() return, so the terminal-status write failed silently while the in-memory task still reported Complete; the underlying failure was that NO role held CanUpdate on 'MJ: Queue Tasks' (or 'MJ: Queues'), so CodeGen never emitted GRANT EXECUTE on spUpdateQueueTask. Developer + Integration CRUD grants were added to metadata/entity-permissions, matching every other engine-written entity. QU1-QU7 pass. The two schema quirks in the bundle header (the 'Pending' default rejected by CK_QueueTask_Status, and nchar(10) truncating 'In Progress') remain documented-and-worked-around, not asserted, so a later schema fix cannot turn this red.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Queue types load from the DB, drivers resolve via the ClassFactory, and the real queue loop persists terminal task statuses, survives throwing tasks, and honors stop/negative-path contracts.
